messages.subject: Ironhold - Intercreditor Deed and Deed of Subordination
messages.plaintextBody:
Alistair,

Circulating the Intercreditor Deed and the Deed of Subordination for the Aldermarsh loans. The subordination reflects the 6m debt-for-equity conversion and the residual 15m subordinated at 8% PIK, turnover to the Security Agent, and no cash payment before the senior discharge date. Charles Aldermarsh is copied for the shareholder side.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP
22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

Alistair
